description:
Up for auction is a diverse collection of eight vintage and modern timepieces, featured by fine 14K solid gold pieces, classic mechanical automatics, and stylish everyday wristwatches.
- Watches are in good used condition. All of the hands move on the watches when setting time. None of the watches are currently working.
- Bulova 23 Vintage Watch: 14K gold case marked "Bulova 14K Gold M2" (Serial #Y39353). Features a chain closure and a gold-filled mesh wristband marked "1/2010K KREISLER" (band requires repair as one link has pulled away).
- Benrus 21 Jewel Vintage Watch: 14K gold case marked "BENRUS 14K Gold" (Serial #780813). Fitted with a comfortable Speidel flexible expansion wristband. Does show some aged patina on the face of the watch.
- Timex Viscount / Automatic Watch Head: Vintage oversized gold-tone watch head measuring approximately 1 3/4" in diameter (no band included). Dial reads "Water Resistant Automatic" with date window. Case back marked "Self Wind, Dust Resistant, Base Metal Bezel, Stainless Steel Back".
- Caravelle Vintage Ladies Watch: Marked "M2" with base metal bezel and stainless steel back. Paired with a gold-tone mesh band in good condition, complete with a safety chain and marked "DUCHESS USA 10 GF TOP".
-Omni Quartz Watch: Classic quartz watch back marked "Omni Quartz Limited, Hong Kong, Base Metal Bezel, Stainless Steel Back" paired with a Speidel wristband.
- Timex Expedition Indiglo: Outdoor sports watch featuring WR 50M water resistance, Indiglo night-light function, and original fabric/leather hybrid strap. Case back marked "Timex Water Resistant".
-Chunky Chain-Link ID Bracelet Watch: Bold statement watch integrated into a thick link bracelet with fold-over closure. Shows cosmetic wear; missing side setting button/stem (sold as-is for parts/repair).
- GG Quartz Turquoise & Rhinestone Watch: Fashion wristwatch featuring a rhinestone-accented bezel, Japanese movement, base metal bezel with stainless steel back, and a vibrant turquoise leather strap.
***Estimated Secondary Market Values
- Bulova 23 (14K Gold Case): $120 - $180 (Value primarily driven by 14K gold melt weight plus vintage brand appeal; account for broken band)
-Benrus 21 Jewel (14K Gold Case): $110 - $160 (Value primarily driven by 14K gold melt weight)
-Timex Automatic Watch Head: $30 - $50 (Popular vintage self-winding automatic series, missing band)
-Caravelle Vintage Mesh Watch: $15 - $25 (Includes 10K gold-filled top Duchess bracelet)
-Timex Expedition Indiglo: $15 - $25 (Reliable everyday functional piece)
- Omni Quartz (Speidel Band): $10 - $15
-GG Quartz Turquoise Rhinestone Watch: $8 - $15
- Chunky Chain-Link ID Bracelet Watch: $5 - $10 (Condition issues / missing stem)
***Total Estimated Lot Value: $313 - $480

description:
This estate collection features a multi-piece lot of vintage and estate pearl jewelry, including classic strands, specialty beads, and boxed earrings.
-The lot includes three beaded style necklaces featuring silver-tone fishhook safety clasps marked "14 KG".
- Included is an 18-inch strand with approximately 8 mm knotted beads; a 20-inch strand with graduated beads ranging from 3.5 mm to 7 mm (retaining its original $75 price tag); and a matching 20-inch strand with graduated 3.5 mm to 7 mm knotted beads.
-Also included in the lot is a 16-inch untested single strand of rice pearls (approx. 9 mm) and a 16-inch double strand beaded necklace fastened with a classic toggle clasp (ring and bar clasp).
- Completing the collection are two pairs of earrings. The first set is a pair of classic Majorca (Mallorca) organic man-made simulated pearl studs (approx. 6 mm) set on 14KT Gold Filled posts, presented in their original green velvet presentation box along with personal provenance paperwork.
- The second set is a pair of pierced single-pearl drop earrings with clear rhinestone accents (approx. 7 mm pearls); one pearl has detached from its setting and is missing a prong, making it an ideal repair project.
-Please note: standard jewelers' testing for pearl authenticity (natural, cultured, or faux) has not been performed on these items; all pieces are sold as-is.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description: This lot includes 12 vintage glass telephone pole insulators primarily manufactured by Hemingray and Whitall Tatum. The insulators are made of clear, aqua, and light green glass and feature embossed branding and model numbers, including Hemingray-42 and Whitall Tatum No. 1. The condition varies among pieces, with some showing visible chips, cracks, and signs of wear consistent with age and use. These insulators are historically significant for telegraph and power line applications and are commonly collected or used as decorative items. Overall, the set is used with minor to moderate damage on certain pieces. Approximately 3.75" D, 4" H each.

Petrified Wood and Agate Specimen Lot
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished and Natural, Brown and Tan, Vintage
This mineral collector's lot features two distinct geological specimens showcasing the beauty of silicified minerals. The first is a rectangular block of polished banded stone, possibly jasper or agatized petrified wood, featuring rhythmic wavy bands of sienna, tan, and cream with a translucent agate corner. The second is a natural rough specimen of petrified wood showing dark internal wood-grain patterns and a characteristic stone-hard fossilized texture.
Polished block displays intricate wavy banding and a translucent agate section at one end
Rough specimen exhibits dark carbon-rich fossilized wood grain and bark-like outer texture
Heavy stone-hard composition consistent with silica-replaced fossilized material
Polished block measures approximately 7 inches in length; total lot weight 2 pounds

GE (General Electric) corporate logo enamel emblems on clips

Instrument length: 5.25 inches

The mechanical pencil appears functional with lead present. The original gift box shows light exterior shelf wear and age-related yellowing to the interior satin lining. Emblems are intact and well-defined.

This vintage Sheaffer writing set represents a classic piece of 1980s corporate advertising history, featuring the iconic Pepsi "Choice of a New Generation" branding. description: Set of vintage Vivitar AT-6 macro extension tubes for SLR cameras. Includes three metal tubes marked 12mm, 20mm, and 36mm.
